name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective GPT-6 Sol/Luna delivery with optional explicitly authorized Astra decision advice.

interface.shortDescription: Sol leads; Luna implements bounded work; Astra advises only with explicit authorization.
interface.longDescription: GPT-6 Sol / xhigh owns architecture, route selection, verification, and acceptance. SELECTIVE ROUTE permits bounded read-only discovery before confirmation. Solo is the default; delegate selects one GPT-6 Luna / max or GPT-6 Sol / xhigh implementer only when work/context savings justify it; audit adds fresh read-only Sol review; full combines one implementer and fresh review as an explicit exception. Material consequence risk requires audit/full. Optional GPT-6 Astra / high advice requires explicit decision-specific user authorization, is read-only, never replaces review, and is not a hard spending cap. Selected role/model/effort evidence fails closed. Terra is retired.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE, confirm it after bounded discovery, then build and verify this feature.
Default to solo, separate difficulty from consequence risk, and never use Astra without explicit authorization.
